title: What is Jasper AI? And how to use it
summary: Learn how Jasper works, who it's for, and how it's priced, so you can gauge whether it makes sense for your marketing team.
body_markdown:
Ryan Kane


Ryan has been working in SaaS for well over a decade and has been evaluating and writing about AI tools since 2022. He uses his years of experience in product development, market research, and web design to help users and decision-makers choose between AI software options, doing in-depth testing and making recommendations with the user in mind. He's tested hundreds of AI tools, automation platforms, and other apps across industries, so he knows what makes an app stand out and has strong opinions about where they fall short. Learn more: ryankane.co.
